item.title: Blue Friday
item.description: Last Friday had seen that Nasdaq wiped out its 2026 gain after Anthropic’s IPO, Jensen Huang’s scandal and the mid-term victory of Democratic party. this may be the start of AI bubble bursting. the reason might be that rate hike in December, and the current price of AI stocks is not sustainable. A blue chip is a stock issued from a well-established, high-quality company that’s seen as reliable and stable.
